options.name: _faked_session
options.description: An internal parameter used for testing the module.

options.name: cpc_name
options.description: Filter pattern to limit returned storage groups to those whose associated CPC has the specified name. If None/null, no such filtering happens.

options.name: fulfillment_state
options.description: Filter to limit returned storage groups to those that have the specified fulfillment state. If None/null, no such filtering happens. For possible values, see the description of property "fulfillment-state" in the data model of the Storage Group object in the R(HMC API,HMC API) book.

options.name: full_properties
options.description: If True, all properties of each storage group will be returned. Default: False. Note: Setting this to True causes a loop of 'Get Storage Group Properties' operations to be executed.

options.name: hmc_auth
options.description: The authentication credentials for the HMC.

options.name: hmc_host
options.description: The hostnames or IP addresses of a single HMC or of a list of redundant HMCs. A single HMC can be specified as a string type or as an HMC list with one item. An HMC list can be specified as a list type or as a string type containing a Python list representation. The first available HMC of a list of redundant HMCs is used for the entire execution of the module.

options.name: log_file
options.description: File path of a log file to which the logic flow of this module as well as interactions with the HMC are logged. If null, logging will be propagated to the Python root logger.

options.name: name
options.description: Filter to limit returned storage groups to those whose name matches the specified regular expression pattern. If None/null, no such filtering happens.

options.name: type
options.description: Filter to limit returned storage groups to those that have the specified type (fcp=FB/FCP, fc=ECKD/FICON). If None/null, no such filtering happens.
